# Prompt Techies (PROMPTTECHIES PRIVATE LIMITED)

> Prompt Techies is the brand of PROMPTTECHIES PRIVATE LIMITED, a DPIIT-recognised (Startup India), MSME-registered technology and student-innovation company headquartered in Hyderabad, Telangana, India. It runs AI workshops, hackathons, bootcamps, mentorship, campus innovation programs and startup building.

- Legal name: PROMPTTECHIES PRIVATE LIMITED
- Brand: Prompt Techies
- Website: https://prompttechies.in
- Head office: Flat No. 304, Plot No. 155 & 156, Sai Lakshmi Residency, IDPL Colony, Bachupally, Medchal-Malkajgiri District, Hyderabad, Telangana 500090, India
- Email: prompttechies@gmail.com
- Phone: +91 8008087702
- Founder & CEO: Saahil Zameer Shaik
